purpose: Find independent full-session RGB video evidence for controlled front/rear pull-up/chin-up and parallel-bar dip counting and set lifecycle.

supported_profile.visibility: both shoulders, elbows and wrists visible without occlusion

candidates.inspection: Complete ZIP central directory inspected through bounded public byte ranges, not extracted or inferred.
candidates.decision: GitHub feature archive is ineligible for full-session RGB validation: all 8,046 files are CSV/TXT. README also points to OneDrive; that separate payload is not inspected here.

candidates.published_claims: Paper describes 84 videos across 54 volunteers and 21 pull-up videos, with independent count annotators.
candidates.decision: Potential pull-up lead only. No usable download URL was identified in the checked primary page/search. Original video access, supported front/rear views, participant IDs, setup/rest coverage and per-cycle labels remain unverified. Parallel-bar dips are not one of its three reported classes.

candidates.published_access: Project asks an advisor/organization representative to sign its license and email it to obtain data.
candidates.decision: No request or agreement sent. Target exercise coverage and original uncut RGB availability remain unverified. Rendered sequences would not qualify real-camera accuracy.

candidates.inspection: Official project exercise list reviewed before any RGB/depth archive download.
candidates.decision: Ineligible for these exercise cells: its ten listed exercises contain neither pull-ups/chin-ups nor parallel-bar dips.
Already consumed development segments; not fresh full setup/rest sessions or a participant holdout. Do not count repeated source URLs or deliveries as independent athletes/sets.

next: Continue primary-source discovery or source-only eligibility review of genuinely fresh uncut public front/rear sessions. Freeze view, visibility, original-source and participant grouping, cycle/set labels and setup/release/rest intervals before inference. Keep SDK predictions out of annotation and preserve in-profile failures. Physical iPhone readiness/soak remains deferred by owner.
